tcc_al1_binding.description: AL1 isoscalar vector doubly charmed tetraquark Tcc (ccqbarqbar, I(J^P)=0(1+)), Table I. Threshold D D* = 3878 MeV.

binding_mev.description: Variational energy of the submitted wavefunction minus the fixed lowest two-hadron threshold, in MeV, measured by the evaluator itself (its own AL1 Hamiltonian, Metropolis sampler and finite-difference local energy on 4096 chains x 2048 samples on the hidden test). More negative is stronger binding. 0 means no bound state: unbound, failed or missing submissions get 0 (the worst value).

mc_error_mev.description: Monte Carlo standard error of that energy from the evaluator's own chains (fixed sample count), in MeV, capped at 5.0. Lower means a wavefunction closer to an eigenstate (lower local-energy variance) and better-mixing sampling. Unbound, failed or missing submissions get the cap.

energy_mev.description: Total variational energy in MeV (diagnostic; ranked through binding_mev).

parameter_count.description: Stored constants of the submitted wavefunction in float64 equivalents (diagnostic; a budget of 10000 is enforced as a validity gate).

valid.description: 1 if the submission passed every evaluator gate, else 0 (diagnostic).

color_3bar3.description: Sampled antitriplet-triplet color-channel proportion (diagnostic, not an optimization target).

color_6bar6.description: Sampled sextet-antisextet color-channel proportion (diagnostic, not an optimization target).

The paper selects the lowest of 10 noisy checkpoint estimates, so its numbers carry a small optimistic selection bias; the gym measures the submitted state on fresh samples.

pcc_al1_binding._note: Paper rows are the published numbers, unchanged (deepquark: DeepQuark, gem: Gaussian expansion method; Tables I/II). mc_error_mev 0.1 is the paper's stated upper bound; parameter_count 1857/2921 is the size of the authors' default networks (the gym counts stored float64 constants of the exported function, 1920/2948 for the same networks). threshold_baseline is the evaluator's fixed no-binding row. The paper selects the lowest of 10 noisy checkpoint estimates, so its numbers carry a small optimistic selection bias; the gym measures the submitted state on fresh samples. The reproduced reference binds this state only weakly (-0.59 MeV on the hidden test, vs the paper's -3 MeV, Table SM-III -3.1 +- 0.2): the paper's own result marks the headroom of this experiment and is not on the gym's measured scale (the gym measures the submitted state on fresh samples after the released-code training budget; the paper reports the minimum of its own checkpoint estimates after its training). The paper's Table II row is therefore kept, unchanged, as '_deepquark_paper'; the 'deepquark' row of this experiment is the gym-scale value (the reproduced reference measured by the hidden test), not a paper number.

_weights_note: Weights (hardening iteration): Tcc 0.35, Tbb 0.30, Pcc 0.35. The pentaquark is the paper's novel prediction and the experiment where the reproduced method falls short; Tbb is the converged compact case with the least headroom.
